normalizationPolicy: CUSIP is the raw filing key; it is not a ticker and is not sufficient to infer an issuer security master.
Ticker and share class require a verified security-master source and must not be inferred from issuer text.
Sector is a separate classification layer; portfolio weights stay hidden until every displayed row has a verified mapping.
Corporate actions, mergers, share-class changes and put/call rows must be reviewed before cross-quarter aggregation.
An empty records array is an explicit fail-closed state, not evidence that the filing contains no securities.
boundary: SEC information-table rows and CUSIPs are connected. Verified ticker, issuer, share-class, corporate-action and sector mappings are not yet published; no sector weight or portfolio recommendation may be derived.
